description: This file defines a generic internal class `TocTransactionQueue<TService>` that extends `TransactionQueue`. It manages transaction queue operations, specifically handling local commit logic, and interacts with transactional storage, logging, timers, and activation lifecycle components within Orleans's transaction coordination module.

classes.name: TocTransactionQueue
classes.description: A generic internal class that manages transaction queue operations for a specific service type, handling local commit procedures within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: TocTransactionQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transaction queue with dependencies including service, options, resource identifier, deactivate action, storage, clock, logger, timer manager, and activation lifetime.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken when a local transaction commit occurs, adding pre-conditions to storage and invoking base class's local commit handler.
